answer.reason: PayoutState's four members line up one for one with PaySend's four PayoutStatus values. HeldCompliance even copies PO_HELD_COMPLIANCE, which the SDK's doc comment describes as PaySend's own KYC review. The glossary names no payout states at all. The use case only groups Bounced and HeldCompliance for follow-up, so these lines come from the vendor's lifecycle, not from the domain.
